title: The Mirror Wall
hook: The dance studio I clean has one rule: never turn off the lights while you're facing the mirror.
lines: I clean a little dance studio downtown, after the last class goes home.
One whole wall is mirror. And the owner, Miss Adele, gave me one rule.
Never turn off the lights while you're facing the mirror. Always turn your back to it first.
I figured she was worried I'd trip in the dark.
For a whole year, I did it her way. Back to the glass. Click. Out the door.
Then last night, my phone buzzed just as I reached for the switch... and I forgot.
The lights went out. I was staring straight into the glass.
And in the dark, I heard it. Tap. Tap. Tap.
Like ballet shoes... on the other side of the mirror.
I slapped the lights back on.
There was my reflection. Same mop. Same tired face.
But it moved a half second after I did. Every single time.
I didn't finish mopping. I just left.
This morning, Miss Adele called me. She asked why I came back at three a.m.... and danced in the dark until sunrise.
